instruction:
You have been tasked to design a verilog module that will take in a 16-bit input `data_in` and output a 4-bit output `data_out`. The output should be the 4 most significant bits of the input. If any of the least significant bits of the input are high (1), then the output should be set to 4'b1111. 

Write a verilog module that implements the above functionality.
original_rtl:
module data_converter(
    input [15:0] data_in,
    output reg [3:0] data_out
);

always @(*) begin
    if (data_in[3:0] != 4'b0000) begin
        data_out <= 4'b1111; // least significant bits are high
    end else begin
        data_out <= data_in[15:12];
    end
end

endmodule
